name: Sunset Outdoor Supply
old_description: Ventrac tractors offer a unique combination of benefits that no other piece of equipment can offer. Discover how Ventrac is a safer solution to your slope mowing needs.
about:
Sunset Outdoor Supply has operated in Morgantown, West Virginia since 2003. The business is owned by Barry Frey and began as a specialist dealer for Ventrac articulated tractors, later adding TORO lawn mowers, Boss snowplows, and Scag mowers to its lineup.

The company sells new equipment including Ventrac 4000 and 4500 series tractors, TORO zero-turn, stand-on, and walk-behind mowers, Boss snowplows and spreaders, and Scag commercial mowers, along with ice-melt products. A three-person staff runs a full-service repair shop that handles maintenance, emergency breakdowns, and warranty work on the brands it carries. The shop maintains a large on-site parts inventory for Ventrac, TORO, and Boss equipment to minimize customer downtime.

Customers span landscaping contractors, estate owners, farmers, municipal parks departments, and resort operators across West Virginia, western Maryland, and southwestern Pennsylvania. Notable users include Deerhurst Resort in Ontario, which uses Ventrac tractors with snow blowers and brooms to maintain 26 hockey rinks; a private owner in Iowa who operates a Ventrac 4500Z with over 35 attachments on 30-degree slopes; and a tree farm in West Virginia running Ventrac 3000 units.

Frey emphasizes product expertise and hands-on support: the team provides free on-site or in-house demonstrations, offers emergency service for Ventrac and TORO owners, and stocks one of the largest Ventrac parts inventories in the region. All machinery and accessories sold are manufactured in the United States.

name: Suntra MedTech Solutions
old_description: Who founded Suntra, and what is the background behind the company?
about:
Operating from Bedford, New Hampshire, Suntra MedTech Solutions (doing business as Sunrise Labs Inc.) has been a medical device development partner for over 30 years. The company was created by industry veterans who wanted the kind of collaborative, insider-built partner they themselves needed while working inside product companies.

Suntra provides consulting, systems engineering, custom healthcare software development, and regulatory strategy for medical device innovators. Its ISO 13485:2016‑certified organization takes a top‑down approach that aligns user needs, business goals, and regulatory requirements. The multidisciplinary team handles projects ranging from complex electro‑mechanical systems to digital health solutions for hospital, laboratory, and home use, offering project‑based consulting, embedded team engagements, and full‑cycle development support.

The firm serves medtech companies developing Class II and Class III devices, combination products, inhalers, and connected health platforms. Clients include visionary medtech leaders who need to validate concepts, scale innovation pipelines, or add specialized engineering capacity. Suntra’s work spans connectivity, intelligence (IoT/AI), simplicity in user experience, and built‑in security for data protection and compliance.

What sets Suntra apart is its insider perspective: the team is built by veterans from product companies who apply engineering precision, custom software expertise, and medtech savvy to move ideas from whiteboard to bedside. Core values of engineering excellence, integrity, respect for people, and continuous improvement guide every engagement.

name: Superb Metals
old_description: We deliver high-performance standing seam metal roofing and commercial building envelope solutions engineered for durability and architectural excellence.
about:
Superb Metals was founded in 1986 in Minneola, Florida, as a supplier of architectural sheet metal for roofing and building envelope applications.

The company custom fabricates standing seam metal roof systems to project specifications and produces custom flashing components such as chimney caps, radius coping, window pans, and Z flashing. It also operates a wholesale division supplying drip edge, butyl tape, RoofIvent Roto vents, Ecos, and other standing seam roofing accessories. A proprietary mechanically seamed system, branded the Guardian System, is engineered to meet Florida’s Miami-Dade building code for extreme wind resistance.

Superb Metals serves roofing contractors and homeowners across central Florida, with project examples including high-end residential roofs in Tavares and commercial building envelopes. Its customer base spans both new construction and renovation projects requiring durable, energy-efficient metal roofing and flashing solutions.

The company’s stated mission emphasizes fast turnaround, personalized consultation drawn from over 40 years of industry experience, fair pricing, and responsive customer service. Its Guardian System is marketed as a storm-rated solution capable of withstanding winds over 325 mph, positioning the firm as a specialist in code-compliant, high-performance metal roofing.

name: Superior Artisan Wood
old_description: At Superior Artisan Wood in Tupelo, Mississippi, we are committed to sustainable practices, producing urban wood while weaving together the rich stories — and memories — held by our community's trees. As the region’s most experienced and certified urban wood producer, we create wood products that honor both heritage and the environment. By preserving wood that would otherwise go to waste, we actively contribute to reducing our carbon footprint and preserving not just natural resources, but the living memories rooted in our local landscape.
about:
Based in Tupelo, Mississippi, Superior Artisan Wood has established itself as the state's only certified urban wood producer. The company processes locally sourced trees that might otherwise be wasted, turning urban wood into high-quality lumber and slabs while emphasizing heritage and sustainability.

The company provides custom mobile and stationary sawmilling for logs up to 60 inches in diameter, vacuum kiln drying to a target moisture content of 6–8 percent, wood sanitization, and sales of premium native hardwood lumber. Its sawmill produces dimensional lumber, beams, mantels, and custom live-edge slabs. Services are offered both at its Tupelo facility and on-site for customers across Lee County and North Mississippi.

Superior Artisan Wood serves woodworkers, contractors, arborists, homeowners, designers, and municipalities. Builders, furniture makers, and DIY enthusiasts purchase its rotating selection of kiln-dried hardwoods, while the log donation program allows community members to give fallen trees a second life.

The business emphasizes sustainability, aiming to reduce landfill waste and carbon emissions by preserving urban trees. It markets itself as the only certified urban wood producer in Mississippi, highlighting a commitment to heritage and environmental impact.

old_description: Superior Moulding of Nevada has been servicing Southern Nevada since 1998. Please visit our showroom located right here in Las Vegas to view all the different mouldings we offer for purchase.
about: Superior Moulding of Nevada was founded in 1998 in Las Vegas, Nevada, as a family-owned business. The company operates a showroom and distribution facility in Las Vegas, stocking hundreds of moulding patterns—including crown, base, door casing, chair rail, panel mouldings, corbels, columns, appliques, and ceiling medallions—in both stain-grade hardwoods (poplar, red oak, cherry, mahogany, white oak, birch, alder, maple) and paint-grade MDF. It also supplies interior and exterior doors, barn and pocket door systems, and related hardware. Local delivery is available throughout the Las Vegas Valley. Superior Moulding serves residential contractors, remodelers, builders, and interior designers in Southern Nevada, providing materials for home renovation and new construction projects. The business emphasizes a large in-stock inventory for immediate pickup, personalized one-on-one assistance, and partnerships with brands such as Metrie, Fypon, Orac Decor, and Emtek to offer a broad selection.

name: Superior Wire Harness
old_description: Custom wire harness manufacturers design and assembly tailored wiring systems, providing durable, high-quality solutions for industrial, medical, automotive, and all electrical applications.
about:
Superior Wire Harness is headquartered in Golden, Colorado, and has been operating since 1996. The company is an American-owned and operated business that began as a provider of custom wire harness and cable assembly services, expanding over nearly three decades into a full-service electronic manufacturing partner.

The company designs and builds custom wire harnesses, cable assemblies, electro-mechanical sub-assemblies, and electrical box builds. It also runs plastic injection molding and custom tooling operations, offering turnkey electronic manufacturing services (EMS) including PCB assembly, power cords, and sealed lead-acid battery integration. Production scales from prototype and sample runs to high-volume wire harness and cable assembly output, supported by domestic and offshore manufacturing options with USA warehousing.

Superior serves industrial, medical, automotive, and aerospace customers, as well as commercial and consumer markets. Its client base includes OEMs and ODMs requiring Tier 2 manufacturing, PPAP documentation at all levels, and UL/CSA-certified components.

The company emphasizes its “Superior Way of Manufacturing,” built on a quality system certified to IATF 16949, ISO 9001, ISO 13485, AS9100D, and IPC/WHMA-620 standards. It differentiates itself with in-house engineering support, all PPAP levels, custom tooling, and a logistics network that provides worldwide delivery from U.S. warehouses.

name: Surface Mount Technology Corp.
old_description: Electronics Manufacturing for Complex Products That Need to Work
about:
Surface Mount Technology Corporation (SMT) was founded in 1997 in Appleton, Wisconsin. The company operates as an electronic manufacturing services (EMS) provider, offering engineering, prototyping, production, test, and higher-level assembly for original equipment manufacturers.

SMT delivers a connected suite of services that spans electronic design engineering, new product introduction, printed circuit board assembly, conformal coating, in-circuit and functional testing, custom test fixture development, supply chain management, and final product integration including enclosure assembly, cabling, labeling, serialization, and packaging. The company runs a state-of-the-art facility in Appleton, though its square footage and headcount are not publicly disclosed.

The firm serves OEMs in industrial controls, instrumentation, test and measurement, automation, medical and medical-adjacent electronics, transportation and mobility, energy and environmental technology, and safety and security systems. Customers typically engage SMT when they need engineering, sourcing, manufacturing, test, and assembly to function as a single execution system rather than a series of handoffs.

SMT says its differentiation lies in quoting only what it can actually build, aligning design with execution early, using real-time operating visibility across work orders, material readiness, and capacity, supporting the full product lifecycle from concept through sustaining support, and being right-sized for complex OEM programs with the responsiveness of a smaller organization.

name: Swagelok Louisiana
old_description: Swagelok Louisiana, founded in 1959, is the authorized distributor of Swagelok® fluid system components in Louisiana and southern Mississippi..
about:
Swagelok Louisiana operates from its headquarters in Baton Rouge, Louisiana, with additional offices in Lake Charles, Lafayette, and New Orleans. Founded in 1959, the company serves as the authorized distributor for Swagelok® fluid system components across Louisiana and southern Mississippi. Ownership details and founder names are not publicly disclosed.

The company distributes Swagelok tube fittings, valves, regulators, and related fluid system components while also providing a range of value‑added services. These include engineering services such as fluid system evaluation, hose evaluation, sample system evaluation, and steam system evaluation; compressed gas leak detection; assembly and fabrication of custom hose assemblies, grab sampling systems, and mechanical seal support systems; hose fabrication and testing; gas distribution system services; and emergency response. Swagelok Louisiana also runs a training academy offering courses in tube fitting installation, orbital welding, tube bending, and process analyzer sampling systems (PASS), and provides tool and equipment rental. The company notes that its grab sample panels are built locally from 15 standard designs and can be customized.

Swagelok Louisiana serves customers in the chemical and petrochemical, oil and gas, power generation, semiconductor, and alternative fuels industries. Its client base includes industrial plants, refineries, and facilities requiring reliable fluid system components and onsite technical support.

The company emphasizes its local presence and specialized assembly environment as key differentiators, stating that its dedicated service team provides expert solutions for customers’ production and operational challenges. It also highlights hands‑on training programs designed to improve workplace safety, efficiency, and productivity.

name: Swift Creek Trading Co
old_description: Over the years it built a solid business around Western Clothing, Footwear and Tack.
about:
Swift Creek Trading Co. operates from Afton, Wyoming, a small town on the route to Yellowstone and Jackson Hole. The business was established in 1990 by Michael Horn, who remains the owner and operator. Horn describes the shop as his "fantasy factory," opening early and closing late to serve both locals and the millions of tourists passing through.

The company combines a traditional western retail store with an in-house custom apparel operation called SwiftWear. The retail side stocks western clothing, footwear, tack, gifts, souvenirs, toys, cowboy hats, knives, and collectibles. SwiftWear provides full-color direct-to-garment (DTG) printing on garments such as Bella Canvas t-shirts, offering fast turnaround with in-store service while customers wait. Orders range from single pieces to thousands.

Customers include tourists visiting Yellowstone and Grand Teton, local residents, businesses, teams, and event organizers seeking custom branded apparel. The shop also houses "Country's Cowboys Corner," an officially licensed University of Wyoming Cowboys gift and souvenir shop, serving collegiate fans.

Horn's stated mission is to master future technology to preserve small-town American business. The company emphasizes speed and convenience, promoting same-day custom printing as a differentiator in a rural market.
